$comment: Files the live gate sends. A fixture is a byte copy of its source at a pinned commit, kept under test/vendor/ with its upstream's licence. A mutation is a listed fixture with one exact text replaced once, built at run time by scripts/fixtures.mjs; `sha256` is the result's. test/app.test.mjs checks every sha256.

mutations.name: 01.01a-INVOICE_uncefact-BR-CO-16
mutations.breaks: BR-CO-16 of EN 16931-1, as the EN 16931 CII Schematron 1.3.16 words it: "Amount due for payment (BT-115) = Invoice total amount with VAT (BT-112) -Paid amount (BT-113) +Rounding amount (BT-114)." The base file has GrandTotalAmount 336.9 and no prepaid or rounding amount, so a DuePayableAmount of 0.01 fails it.
